title: Allow named overflow tooltips
Support named setlist actions
prompt:
In lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart, replace `List<UnifiedItemAction> buildSetlistActions({
  required String quick,` with `List<UnifiedItemAction> buildSetlistActions({
  String? setlistName,
  required String quick,`. Replace `      tooltip: pinnedLabel,` with `      tooltip: setlistName == null ? pinnedLabel : '$pinnedLabel for $setlistName',`. Replace `    OverflowMenuAction(
      entries: [` with `    OverflowMenuAction(
      tooltip: setlistName == null ? 'More' : 'More options for $setlistName',
      entries: [`. The optional name preserves existing callers and their tests. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'More options for $setlistName' lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart && rg -Fq '$pinnedLabel for $setlistName' lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/unified_item/setlist_card_actions.dart && flutter test test/widgets/setlist_card_actions_test.dart

title: Name actions on setlist rows
prompt:
In lib/screens/setlists/setlists_list_screen.dart, replace the unique lines `        return buildSetlistActions(
          quick: quick,` with `        return buildSetlistActions(
          setlistName: setlist.name,
          quick: quick,`. This gives the pinned action and More button labels that identify their setlist. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'setlistName: setlist.name,' lib/screens/setlists/setlists_list_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/setlists/setlists_list_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/setlists/setlists_list_screen_test.dart
